title: AKM Windows hardening
goal: Fix credential leaks and data-loss blockers, then prove them against real Windows artifacts.
tier: Tier 2: three independent implementation units plus frontend integration; high data-integrity risk

stages.name: Implement
stages.why: Exclusive file ownership and fixed Rust/IPC contracts prevent conflicting edits. Large implementation and regression-test output can proceed independently.
stages.input: PHASE1.md, verified adversarial findings, source snapshot
stages.output: Core, CLI and native desktop fixes with targeted regression tests

nodes.name: Vault persistence
nodes.reason: Large implementation and test unit; routing presets are unavailable in this harness.
nodes.check: 40 unit/integration tests pass; planner journal-concurrency regression passes; real KeePassXC interchange passes

nodes.name: Windows CLI
nodes.reason: Independent command handling and subprocess tests; model selection not requested.
nodes.check: 19 executable and 2 unit regressions pass; integration review pending

nodes.name: Native lifecycle
nodes.reason: Independent Windows clipboard/session APIs and native lifecycle tests.
nodes.check: 31 native tests pass; opt-in real clipboard proof passes; real app lock/suspend/exit/affinity proof passes

stages.name: Integrate and prove
stages.output: Rebuilt Windows executable, regression results, KeePassXC and UI evidence

nodes.name: Planner integration
nodes.reason: Uses existing project context and avoids another worker re-reading it.
nodes.check: 93 workspace tests, strict Clippy/format, 7 frontend tests, 4 browser scenarios, release bundles, real KeePassXC and native GUI proof passed

stages.name: Review
stages.input: PHASE1.md, combined diff, exact verification commands; no worker reasoning
stages.output: Ranked findings and a decision on phase-1 blockers

nodes.name: First fresh review failed
nodes.reason: Independent context found six supported race and export defects.
nodes.check: FAIL: three high and three medium findings require corrections

stages.name: Correct review findings
stages.why: The clipboard writer and CLI exporter own independent files and need substantial native implementation/tests. The planner keeps coupled session, UI and GUI-export changes together.
stages.input: Six findings, scratch probes, correction contracts in PHASE1.md
stages.output: Permanent race/failure regressions and corrected outcomes, previews, clipboard and exports

nodes.name: Session and UI races
nodes.reason: Coupled cancellation semantics and frontend epochs reuse the planner's context.
nodes.check: Committed outcome, lock nonblocking and deferred frontend regressions pass; exact-release proof pending

nodes.name: Atomic clipboard ownership
nodes.reason: Independent Windows publication API implementation and failure/interleaving tests; presets unavailable.
nodes.check: 15 clipboard tests pass including publication ownership and partial failure; real flags proof pending

nodes.name: CLI export failure safety
nodes.reason: Independent native ACL, file publication and injected-failure regression output; no model selection requested.
nodes.check: 27 executable/helper regressions pass including cleanup, no-overwrite and unsupported ACL storage

stages.name: Rebuild and re-review
stages.why: Application source is stable. Read-only review uses separate scratch probes and cannot touch the GUI or clipboard while the planner completes native proof scripts.
stages.input: Collected correction diff and permanent regressions
stages.output: Exact release evidence and fresh acceptance verdict; no readiness score inferred

nodes.name: Combined verification
nodes.reason: One final full verification pass avoids duplicate build work.
nodes.check: Historical candidate: 117 workspace, 19 frontend and 4 browser tests plus builds/KeePassXC passed; later clipboard/runtime failures were corrected in the following stages

nodes.name: Fresh correction review
nodes.reason: A new independent context checks the combined diff against the plan, not worker explanations.
nodes.check: FAIL: desktop temp ownership, opening error, bootstrap retry, hidden import and Unix-doc defects; real clipboard also failed

stages.name: Repair runtime and review failures
stages.why: Windows clipboard synthesis and file-handle publication require independent native implementations. The planner keeps all frontend/session error flows together.
stages.input: Second fresh review probes and real clipboard sequence failure; PHASE1.md second-correction ownership
stages.output: Owned-handle export, valid native clipboard lease, visible fenced errors and completed native proof

nodes.name: Windows clipboard lifecycle
nodes.reason: New native runtime evidence requires a focused implementation; stronger unrequested model selection is not available.
nodes.check: 20 deterministic clipboard tests and the planner-run real Windows sequence/private flags/cleanup test pass

nodes.name: Owned desktop export
nodes.reason: Independent mechanical port of proven handle ownership and native failure regressions.
nodes.check: 14 owned-file/path/ACL regressions pass, including renamed/replaced temp cancellation and publication

nodes.name: Terminal UI outcomes
nodes.reason: Error fencing and boot/import lifecycle reuse coupled session/frontend context.
nodes.check: Review regressions and cross-session receipt test pass; 132 workspace, 24 frontend and 4 browser tests pass

stages.name: Acceptance recheck
stages.why: Application source is frozen. Read-only review uses its own scratch and cannot touch GUI/clipboard while the planner verifies rebuilt artifacts.
stages.input: Combined correction diff, source hashes, PHASE1.md contracts and current verification results
stages.output: Exact release evidence, fresh review verdict and explicit residual gates without a projected score

nodes.name: Exact release verification
nodes.reason: One collector owns real OS interaction and avoids concurrent clipboard or GUI tests.
nodes.check: Final GUI 95396108 rebuilt after P3; resumed exact-path save/cancel, clipboard, synthetic session/power, exit and affinity passed. Prior imports/clone/upgrade and unchanged CLI/KeePassXC evidence preserved; process/settings cleanup verified

nodes.name: Fresh acceptance review
nodes.reason: Independent context is required after supported corrections, not another pass over a knowingly failed candidate.
nodes.check: Approved within phase-1 correction scope after sole P3 lock-reply feedback fix; both new regressions independently passed. No new numerical readiness verdict

gates.name: Regression tests
gates.rule: 132 workspace, 24 frontend and 4 browser checks preserved; affected App/receipt 10-test run passed after final P3; strict Clippy/format and standalone real clipboard passed

gates.name: Real Windows artifact
gates.rule: Final frontend/GUI/MSI/NSIS rebuilt; only remaining native proof resumed and passed on that GUI. Completed unaffected probes were not repeated

gates.name: Independent review
gates.rule: Merged source-correction verdict approved after the bounded P3 fix; no higher readiness score inferred

gates.name: Real-secret readiness
gates.rule: Blocked: actual OS lock/suspend delivery and wall-clock idle need owner-assisted checks; later hardening, signing and professional review remain. Original 40.5/100 score unchanged; an independent score above 90 followed by testing is still required

notes: A source archive preserves the pre-change baseline without initializing git. PR/merge is not applicable; no push or publication was requested.
Frontend integration follows fixed IPC contracts; no concurrent edits to native Rust files.
This graph supports code fixes, not a separate analytical deliverable. No Canvas is needed.
Final correction review and remaining native checks passed; the blocked readiness gate covers wider trust/manual-coverage work, not unresolved supported phase-1 source defects.
Settings were restored byte-for-byte to the durable recovery baseline, which points to a fake vault. The unknown pre-restart original preference was not guessed.
Synthetic Windows messages prove handlers, not actual OS delivery. No score above 90 is claimed from tests alone.
